title: SQL & Data Modeling: Schemas, Constraints & Transactions
concept: Design the tables behind a real application and keep its data correct: entities and relationships, primary and foreign keys, normalization, CRUD, joins and aggregates, constraints, transactions and safe schema changes, each taught from a data bug on a learning platform. Queries run on SQLite.
description: A beginner course for developers who store data in a relational database and want the data to stay right. Every lesson starts from a data incident on the CodeDev learning platform - a learner enrolled twice in the same course, a progress report that counts lessons three times, a course deleted while learners were still enrolled, an enrollment saved without its progress row - and fixes it in SQL: modeling entities and cardinality, choosing keys, normalizing, writing CRUD, joins and GROUP BY without double counting, NOT NULL, UNIQUE, CHECK and foreign keys, transactions, stopping duplicate rows from concurrent requests, and changing a live schema safely. 10 lessons with quizzes on real data and hands-on SQL challenges.

learningOutcomes.text: Model entities and relationships with the right primary keys, foreign keys and normalized tables
Write CRUD, join and GROUP BY queries that return exactly the rows intended
Use NOT NULL, UNIQUE, CHECK and foreign keys so the database refuses bad data
Keep related writes in one transaction and stop duplicate rows under concurrent requests

testedVersions.SQLite: sqlite3 module of the code runner's python3 (Ubuntu 26.04)

knownIssues: Runs on SQLite, not PostgreSQL: no EXPLAIN plans, and locking under concurrent writes differs from PostgreSQL
